title: Launch Signal Map and Tactical Timeline for Cross-Channel Release Notes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create an operational 'signal map' and tactical timeline that sequences blog, email, social, and webinar touchpoints with final release notes publication. Ensure alignment across Engineering, Design, DevRel, Growth, and Support; consolidate PRs and release-note artifacts; and provide a runbook for last-minute content freeze, rollback messaging, and post-launch metrics.
tasks: Draft channel-level message matrix (blog/email/social/webinar) with owner and CTA
Lock final release notes doc and create stable permalink (Confluence)
Collect engineering change summaries and breaking-change flags from ENG leads
Create pre-launch approval checklist and sign-off flow for Legal/Trust/Design
Schedule webinar dry-run and create Q&A doc for Support and Sales
Prepare social card designs and blog feature hero assets with DES
Define metric dashboard (launch pulse) and wire alert thresholds for regressions
Publish coordinated Slack/GitHub announce templates for internal teams
updates: 2025-02-10: Ticket created after kickoff with PM, ENG, DES, Growth. Agreed high-level scope: blog + email + social + webinar + official release notes.
2025-02-14: ENG provided summary of breaking changes and migration notes (see link). Marked two items as 'breaking' that require amplified messaging in blog and email.
2025-02-18: Design first pass received. Need alternate hero for dark-mode. DES request: 1 more business day to finalize assets.
2025-02-21: Decision: webinar will be product-focused (30 min) with live Q&A. Speaker lineup confirmed (CTO + PM + engineer). Action: schedule dry-run on 2025-03-10.
2025-02-25: Legal review queued. Legal flagged one line in release notes around customer data handling; PM updated wording and requested re-approval.
2025-02-28: PRD and release-notes draft linked; internal review started. Requesting ENG and Support to add troubleshooting snippets for two edge cases.
2025-03-01: Growth suggested A/B subject lines for email; agreed to test two variants for open-rate optimization. Added to email send plan.
2025-03-03: Final channel timeline (with UTC times, embargo windows, and CDN invalidation steps) circulated. Minor timing shift for APAC social posts to align with regional comms.
2025-03-04: Content freeze declared for all channels. Drafts locked for final proofreading. Next steps: approvals and schedule publish via Growth Console.
acceptance_criteria: Master release notes doc published with stable permalink and version tag
All channel messages approved by Legal and Design
Webinar scheduled and dry-run completed with speaker confirmations
Assets uploaded to CDN and social scheduling slots booked
Launch pulse dashboard active and baseline metrics captured pre-launch
notes: Trade-offs discussed: we chose a single coordinated publish + staggered regional social posts to maximize visibility while minimizing rollback blast radius. If a critical rollback is needed, the runbook prioritizes email cancel/update + pinned blog notice + webhook to autoscaling to disable new deployments. Post-launch, measure feature adoption and error rates over 72 hours before wide enterprise announcements.
